cypher_query:
MATCH (c:Client)-[o:OPPORTUNITY]->(p:Product)
WHERE o.opportunity_stage IN ['Closed Won', 'Closed Lost']
WITH p.name AS product,
count(CASE WHEN o.opportunity_stage = 'Closed Won' THEN 1 END) AS won_deals,
count(CASE WHEN o.opportunity_stage = 'Closed Lost' THEN 1 END) AS lost_deals,
count(o) AS total_deals
WITH product, won_deals, lost_deals, total_deals,

ORDER BY success_rate DESC, total_deals DESC
RETURN product, won_deals, lost_deals, total_deals, success_rate
